text:
Assistant A provides no program at all, only a single sentence claiming to have one. It fails to implement anything.

Assistant B provides a working two-pointer implementation with an example and an explanation. It assumes the arrays are sorted, which is not stated explicitly, and it doesn't handle duplicates in the usual way. It also doesn't mention that a generator is arguably a bit of a loose reading of "no extra data structures". Still, it is a correct and useful answer for sorted input and is far more helpful than A.

[[B]]
